sources.entry: QorumLogs - Swift Logging Utility for Xcode & Google Docs.

summary.one_liner: QorumLogs is a Swift logging utility for iOS/tvOS apps that prints leveled, colorized logs to the Xcode debug area and can optionally send them to Google Docs.
use_cases: Printing leveled debug, info, warning and error logs in Xcode
Filtering Xcode console output to a single Swift file
Sending production app logs to a Google Doc
Adding colored log output to an iOS or tvOS project
Attaching user information to remote log entries
how_to_run: Install XcodeColors via Xcode's Package Manager (Window > Package Manager)
Install with Carthage: github "goktugyil/QorumLogs" in Cartfile
Or download QorumLogs.swift and drop it into your project
Call QorumLogs.enabled = true and QorumLogs.test() to verify
Use QL1 to QL4 functions to print logs
notable: Log levels QL1 to QL4 with a minimum-level filter, plus separate online (Google Docs) logging
onlyShowThisFile filter to show logs from one class or file only
Optional KZLinkedConsole support for clickable log locations
Works in both night and light Xcode modes
caveats: Requires the XcodeColors Xcode plugin for colored output, which uses Alcatraz and may need Xcode restarts
Google Docs integration is optional and takes setup time; README says about 4 minutes
CocoaPods requires importing the framework in every file, per the README
Tested only on Xcode 6.4, iOS 7.1 and tvOS 9 according to the README; the README is dated and the project may be unmaintained
